kill_argument: The strongest remaining objection is that completion of this code cannot establish reliable causal inference under weak overlap or hidden selection: its Wald intervals rely on regular parametric fits and an IID row bootstrap, and its diagnostics cannot verify exchangeability. That limits the eventual claim rather than showing a departure from the explicitly conditional approved design. I attacked the ATT denominator and augmentation, nuisance refitting, placebo covariate exclusions, TOST tails, five-test Holm adjustment, failure suppression, forbidden-outcome reads and declared execution inputs; these match the plan on inspection. An artificial-weight arithmetic check did not substantiate a suspected intercept rounding failure. No study data were opened or estimates run. The remaining concrete defect is stale execution documentation claiming unresolved D1/D2 blockers after the prospective clarifications were recorded.
